title: Second Lessons: Stars
introNarration: Lumen taps the Primer. Ink has dried on her primaries in a constellation of honest mistakes. "Cast azimuth at the hearth dummy in this room. Then talk to me. After that, the book will offer three leaves. Type 1, 2, or 3 when it does."
reminderNarration: Cast azimuth at the hearth dummy in this hearth, then talk to Lumen. Charts before wonder.
completionNarration: The second hearth lesson is done. The Primer lies open under the night windows. Type 1, 2, or 3 when it offers three leaves.
